name: BAR-ROCK
author: keste
description: A polyphonic harpsichord for VIBE FM: 16 allocation-free Karplus-Strong voices, two slightly detuned 8' choirs, a two-pole soundboard, fixed-memory stereo reverb and a bar-fly-derived colour rack. Thirty-two registrations in two banks: 1-16 are CLEAN (soundboard + reverb only), 17-32 add curated FX scenes with solid/tube distortion, clean-room dual-rotor Leslie, phaser, chorus, flanger, tremolo, auto-pan, ring mod, lo-fi crush and ping-pong/tape echo. Pads 1-16 select a slot in the current bank, F2/F4 browse all 32, the SOUND page has a BANK menu, and F3/PLAY plays a 12-second Dido snippet that loops by default for hands-free FX testing. DC-blocked before the reverb and after the rack so looped playback cannot rattle speakers. No samples, no impulse responses, no heap.
